name: Antonio Gramsci
role: Italian Marxist theorist and co-founder and leader of the Italian Communist Party (1891–1937)
summary: Gramsci was a Marxist and Leninist revolutionary who argued that workers should build councils in factories and villages as the base of a new proletarian state, led by a disciplined communist party allied with the peasantry. He opposed fascism, liberal parliamentarism and the Vatican's influence, and in his prison notebooks analysed how ruling classes hold power through consent and cultural hegemony as well as force.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Held that capitalist competition is disorder to be replaced by association, and called laissez-faire itself a form of state regulation.

public-ownership.rationale: Looked to the socialisation of capitalism and suppression of private property by a council-based state, though stressing control by producers more than state ownership.

unions-good.rationale: Saw unions as defence organs that limit capitalists' arbitrary power and as the 'vertebrae' of the proletarian body, while criticising their bureaucracy and capitalist-period limits.

property-fundamental.rationale: Wrote that the socialist state must suppress private property, and that its continuation endangers poor peasants and workers.

worker-ownership.rationale: Argued the factory council organised producers to take ownership of production definitively, with workers' control of each factory.

state-harmful.rationale: Mixed: foresaw a communist society not subordinated to an organised state power, but held that a proletarian state of councils is needed in the transition.

more-religion-public.rationale: Called the Vatican an international enemy of the revolutionary proletariat and criticised Gentile's claim that religion is good for the people.

gradual-change.rationale: Held that the socialist state cannot be formed inside the capitalist state's institutions and that changing personnel is not enough, while allowing that building it takes preparatory work.

nation-first.rationale: Insisted on internationalism: the party is a section of a world party and the Lyons Theses fault weak internationalist spirit.

revolution-justified.rationale: Argued that conquering power requires revolution and the dictatorship of the proletariat, and led a party founded on that aim.

central-planning.rationale: Inferred: he wanted competition and private property suppressed and production coordinated by councils for the community, which implies non-market coordination, but he never set out a planning scheme in these texts.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Described the council as an organisation of producers, not of wage-earners who are slaves of capital, and looked to a classless communist society.

one-party-rule.rationale: Held that the party is the supreme power that harmonises the working class and defended the Leninist unity of the ruling Russian party, while calling for a workers' and peasants' council state.

democracy-best.rationale: Mixed: called a parliament elected by exploiters and exploited the mask of bourgeois dictatorship, yet defended the elective system and the need for majority consent and accepted a democratic phase as a stage.

workers-councils.rationale: Made councils of workers and peasants the basis of the new state: 'All state power to the worker and peasant councils', set against parliament.

natural-rulers.rationale: Treated the divide between rulers and ruled as a social fact to be minimised and eliminated by changing conditions.

political-violence-never.rationale: Wanted the proletariat armed to defeat the bourgeoisie and defended armed resistance to fascists as part of a mass revolutionary struggle.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Framed Italian and European history through class alliances and the irreconcilable antagonisms of capitalist society.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Described unions equalising conditions of labour and pay nationally as the concrete basis of communist equality.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Contrasted capitalist free competition and individualism with association and solidarity as the proletarian principle.

restore-past-order.rationale: Called the fascist and agrarian ascendancy a historical regression and the largest phenomenon of regression, not an order to restore.

direct-action.rationale: Mixed: said fascism cannot be defeated without direct mass action and that spontaneous unionism is insufficient, yet used elections and parliament tactically and warned against action for its own sake.

means-match-ends.rationale: Wrote 'Whoever wants the ends, should want the means' and presented the factory council as the model of the communist state.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Described councils built on trades and hierarchies of competence, and a common school followed by specialised schools, rather than ending specialisation.

production-for-use.rationale: Described the factory council as organising production for the community with solidarity replacing competition, and agricultural production redirected to peasants' needs.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Named the freedom to extract surplus value as the first source of capitalist power.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Insisted the formula must become real: a new proletarian state of councils through which the working class rules until classes disappear.

collective-farming.rationale: Held that modernising Italian agriculture should happen in a socialist state with peasants and workers associated in communist work units, farms controlled by agricultural workers.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Endorsed Leninism as the Marxism of monopoly capitalism, imperialist wars and proletarian revolution, and described imperialism as export of finance capital.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Reacted energetically against the positivist anthropology that treated the South's poverty as biological inferiority, calling it 'science' used to crush the wretched.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Mixed: treated ideologies and intellectuals as functions of class hegemony and 'science' as serving power, but also valued disciplined scientific study.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Organised factory councils electing delegates with conditional mandates to control production and dismiss hostile staff in each company.

class-collaboration.rationale: Insisted on hardening the separation of classes and rejected collaboration with the bourgeoisie in parliament and government.

workers-nation.rationale: Attacked the bourgeois notion of a 'proletarian nation' as a distortion of Marx and placed the party within a world party.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Wrote that the state gathers the power of the propertied class and keeps its privilege, and in the notebooks added consent and hegemony to coercion.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Described parliament as corrupt to the bone, a talking and scandal shop that lost prestige, and the Southern ruling class as corrupt.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Looked to a state that directs the economy and suppresses classes and private property, not one limited to defence and property.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Rejected Gentile's reasoning for religious teaching in primary school: the dogma and mythology needed there need not be those of religion.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Mixed: stressed winning the consent of the peasant majority and defended the elective system, but also held to proletarian dictatorship over former ruling classes.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Justified revolutionary force and armed workers' defence against the bourgeois state.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Saw competition as the capitalist disorder to be suppressed by association and solidarity.

vanguard-party.rationale: Held that spontaneity never takes workers beyond bourgeois democracy and the party must represent advanced consciousness and lead.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Traced mass emigration and weakness of Italy to the incapacity of the capitalist system to feed and house the population.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Required a centralised party under iron proletarian discipline, no organised factions, with decisions formed through election and debate.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Approvingly recounted Turin workers' armed insurrection against Italian militarism in 1917 and the general opposition to the imperialist war, but not an explicit doctrine of defeatism.

people-in-arms.rationale: Wanted the proletariat armed and the councils to train the masses militarily, though not explicitly to abolish professional armies.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Praised teaching scientific ideas against the magical conception of the world absorbed from folklore.

constituent-assembly.rationale: Mixed: in 1919 judged a constituent assembly only a formal correction of the democratic state, while in the notebooks he faulted Risorgimento moderates for refusing one.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: Treated the USSR as on the road to socialism and defended the unity of its Leninist leadership.

character-from-environment.rationale: Argued that a child's consciousness reflects its social surroundings, and that class relations shape people, but did not state a general view on innate nature.

land-redistribution.rationale: Backed 'land to the peasants' as a realistic slogan within a joint revolutionary action of workers and peasants, warning against mechanical sharing out of estates.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Called the Bolshevik revolution 'against Capital', placing men's will above raw economic facts, and denounced fatalistic readings of Marx.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: Warned that comrades drifting into small armed groups depart from Marxism's revolutionary self-activity of the proletariat, and that such groups matter only linked to mass reaction.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: Mixed: rejected fatalistic collapse theories, while writing that capitalism's intrinsic weakness forces it into expedients and crises.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: Mixed: described a labour aristocracy allied to the bourgeoisie, but treated workers generally as exploited.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Wrote 'I hate the indifferent': to live is to be a citizen and take part, and indifference is cowardice and parasitism.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: Described the press as manipulating opinion for government and capitalists and intellectuals as organising consent to the dominant group.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: Described intellectuals as the dominant group's deputies who organise the spontaneous consent of the masses, alongside state coercive apparatus, and wrote of crises of hegemony.

party-own-road.rationale: Held that the party is centralised internationally and a mere section of a world party, and defended the Comintern line against the opposition.

recallable-delegates.rationale: Had factory delegates elected with a fixed and conditional mandate, so they answer to those who chose them.

industrial-unions.rationale: Held factory councils should follow organisation by industry and approved Russian industrial unions, finding craft unions competitive and sectional.

informal-organisation.rationale: Argued for a centralised disciplined party with trained cadres and warned against short-term action by small groups.

defeat-communism.rationale: Fought for communism as a founder and leader of the Italian Communist Party.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: Said the bourgeoisie represented progress in the Risorgimento and that the proletariat would guard the productive forces capitalism generates.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Answered liberalism and fascism with 'Sovietism' and aimed for communism.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Built a system of workshop and district delegates so workers take part directly in running production and develop political experience.

alienated-labor.rationale: Argued the worker-machine suits employers while workers should be producers and creators in the council, and defended humanistic schooling against mechanised workers.

property-franchise.rationale: Described the cut of Italy's electorate from three million to 800,000 as an extreme dictatorial measure of a weak bourgeois minority.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: Wrote that newspapers manipulate opinion to the wishes of government and capitalists, and noted that fascism destroyed workers' press and meeting freedoms.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Wanted a workers' state that subjects capitalists to the law of useful labour.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Backed armed proletarian resistance to fascist violence.

independent-unions.rationale: Mixed: said unions would operate independently of the state in a communist republic, yet held that the party leads unions through communist fractions.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: Held the socialist state must rest on councils of workers and peasants, with the working class holding political power.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Noted that craft-based organisation won recognition of workers' rights on hours and wages and would continue to do so.

smash-state-machine.rationale: Argued the capitalist state's institutions cannot be taken over, since socialism needs a fundamentally new state, not new personnel.

internal-colonialism.rationale: Wrote that the northern bourgeoisie reduced the South and Islands to exploited colonies, giving it a position like a colonial population.

workers-own-party.rationale: Helped found and lead a communist party independent of the other parties as the organisation of the industrial proletariat.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: Rejected judging a regime by elections alone, calling universal-suffrage parliaments the mask of bourgeois dictatorship.

indirect-election.rationale: Described councils built from elected workshop delegates, then district and urban committees chosen by delegates, up to central bodies.

bypass-parties-groups.rationale: Wrote that the masses do not exist politically unless framed in political parties.

labour-theory-of-value.rationale: Used surplus-value language and the idea that labour should rule, but did not discuss value theory.

notes: Pre-prison (1916-1926) texts and the Lyons Theses are the strongest evidence; the Prison Notebooks are used only where translations were reachable (Modern Prince, parts of State and Civil Society, The Intellectuals, On Education). His views shifted from council-centred writing in 1919-20 to party-led Leninism in 1924-26 and hegemony theory in prison; the later view is used where clear. Texts on Americanism and Fordism, language and religion in the notebooks could not be opened, so those stay null.
